item.title: Startup news and updates: Daily roundup (February 2, 2026)
item.description: YourStory presents the daily news roundup from the Indian startup ecosystem and beyond. Here's the roundup for Monday, February 2, 2026.

item.title: Ather Energy slashes net loss, reports 50% rise in Q3 revenue
item.description: The EV maker managed to maintain its market lead ahead of Bhavish Aggarwal-led Ola Electric this quarter amidst record high sales of its electric scooters.

item.title: How small habits quietly shape the life you’re becoming
item.description: Small daily habits quietly shape who you become. Learn how consistent, simple actions influence your future more than big decisions.

item.title: How emotional overload quietly kills focus and drive
item.description: Emotional overload can quietly drain focus and motivation. Learn why it happens, how it affects your mind, and what helps restore clarity and energy.

item.title: Large deal activity boosts VC funding in Jan 2026 by 30%
item.description: The month of January 2026 saw venture capital funding rise by 30% when compared to January 2025, and this was primarily due to the large volume of deals.

item.title: Ather Energy flags headwinds from commodity prices in coming months
item.description: EV maker Ather Energy has been working hard over the last few quarters to be more disciplined over its fixed costs to better manage potential headwinds later this year, as prices of aluminium and copper see heightened volatility.

item.title: How overthinking quietly steals your daily happiness
item.description: Discover how overthinking drains joy, breaks presence, and traps you in your head—plus simple ways to reclaim calm and daily happiness.

item.title: He turned his father’s terrace into a $300M empire, now he wants to help you create yours
item.description: VDart's Sidd Ahmed sold his house and car in Detroit, started a company from his living room, and then built its heart in Trichy because home is the one place you never stop running towards.

item.title: 63SATS Cybertech raises Rs 245 Cr to build cybersecurity for the AI era

item.title: With state government backing, this Assam startup is reimagining travel and sustainability
item.description: Encamp Adventures is building tourism technology from Assam, combining curated journeys with digital tools for scale. Backed by incubation and financial support from the state, Founder Ratan Kumar Ghimire is taking the venture from Guwahati to Southeast Asia.
